In addition, our gas optimization activities continued to support our margin, reimporting their strategic role in balancing our portfolio and mitigating exposure to spot market volatility.

Energy sales reached 22.7 terawatt hour, mainly due to the lower sales to regulated customers following the aspiration of regulated contracts. First of all, we deployed 376 emergency screw across our service territory. These teams were mobilized to respond to outages and restore power.

This difference is mainly due to the increased tax payment in the generation business, driven by both higher results and higher monthly payment tax rates.

The average terms of our debt maturities decreased from 6.2 years as of December 2024 to 5.5 years as of September 2025, and the portion at the fixed rate is 87% of total debt.
The average cost of our debt reached 4.8% as of September 2025, decreasing from 5.0% in December 2024, in line with our efforts to optimize the financial costs.

We are implementing proactive initiatives to address portfolio dynamics and climate challenges.
